comparison.objective: Pull an extinguisher pin, read its gauge, and file a condition report, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Linear pin extraction, gauge interpretation, and tag placement versus recessed hex-key use, collar adjustment, torque locking, and iterative guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Pin displaced at least 2 cm and tag within 2.5 cm of the correct pad versus two safe damped stops and acceptable post-lock drift.
comparison.reason: This record duplicates pr-1241, but remains distinct from the candidate because it tests inspection/reporting rather than calibration. No spec versions are present, though the body gives the main scoring thresholds.
